application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.source: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-56485-7, p. 4, Results ('300 EVs equipped with NCM lithium-ion batteries')

units_released.note: Rule: one RAR per vehicle. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.source: 300 released vehicles x 96 series cells stated in the paper
cells_liion.note: 96 series positions per pack as stated (paper p. 4); any parallel cells within a position are not stated.

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: Entries in the batteryvoltage field of the first rows with a live pack voltage, per vehicle file in the split RAW_DATA archive: {96: 300}.

energy_mwh.source: 300 vehicles x 96 cells x 155 Ah x 3.65 V / 1,000,000
energy_mwh.note: 155 Ah and 96S are stated (paper p. 4, Results); the 3.65 V nominal cell voltage is our assumption for NCM, not stated in the paper, SI or peer review file.

energy_basis.source: energy_mwh is computed from stated configuration

span_unit_years.source: fielddata.loaders.changan.fleet() (data/fleet_meta.csv, per-vehicle first-to-last terminaltime, made by this collection from the raw files)
span_unit_years.note: About 3.25 years per vehicle, consistent with the paper's three years; not re-measured from the split archive for v1.0. Timestamps were adjusted into seconds by the publisher for privacy (SI Note 2); this assumes the adjustment preserves durations.

obs_hours.note: Spans of the relative timestamps are measurable (no calendar dates); observation-hours are not substituted for unit-years.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: http://ivstskl.changan.com.cn/?p=2697; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
